method: D-AutoRoute: Dense Acquire + Adaptive Q/F/P + Shared Heads + Private MLP Actor-Critics + First-Frame Reconstruction Routing

evaluation.future_task_evaluations: Preserved separately from task acquisition; true_task_is_eligible marks unavailable true routes.

headline.summary: Partial 119/541 epochs; evaluation at 110: CoinRun 7.5; CoinRun+NB 6.875. No final result.

comparability.claim: Timestamped per-seed partial pilot. Different latest epochs are not an aligned final ranking.
limitations: Training uses task IDs; action selection infers routes from observations.
Only task 0 is completed at this snapshot; task 1 is acquiring, and future-task scores do not establish acquired capability.
All five predeclared seeds are retained, including failed/recovered attempts; no outcome-based seed selection.
Exact complete-episode evaluation/reset semantics and all-seen compression selection differ from legacy D.
No final ACC, forgetting or six-task retention claim is supported yet.
Source training revision and runtime repair revision are distinct; this is not bitwise mid-episode recovery.

notes: Boundary continuation with fresh environment resets; not bitwise mid-epoch recovery. Failed suffix compute remains overhead, never new result seeds or extra logical updates.
Raw episode returns, means, population standard deviations and routing confusion are preserved for every captured periodic evaluation.
Periodic evaluation at epoch 90 follows new-route initialization and precedes task-1 online updates.
The complete declared budgets are not a claim that all those updates have already executed.
Running state is an observation at recorded_at_utc, not a permanent live-status claim.
The old failed source and four campaign startup failures are retained in provenance, not counted as replacement seeds.

budgets.scope: Full declared logical run budget, not the partial snapshot consumed budget.

dense_acquisition_bound.scope: online inference parameters; FP32 master weights; excludes optimizer state, gradients, activations, Replay, and boundary world-model teachers

adaptive_compression.selection_metric: every seen task: auto-routed raw episodic return

restored_boundary.environment_resume: fresh resets at the saved boundary, not mid-episode

failed_parent_attempt.error: RuntimeError: Index put requires the source and destination dtypes match, got BFloat16 for the destination and Float for the source.
failed_parent_attempt.phase: First task completed and boundary saved; failed during exact auto-routed evaluation after initialization of task 1, before completing a second-task epoch.

failed_suffix_accounting.partial_collection_and_evaluation: Preserved in original full log/diagnostics; incomplete steps may not have exact counters. Not claimed zero.

resume_lineage.caveat: Boundary continuation with fresh environment resets; not bitwise mid-epoch recovery. Failed suffix compute remains overhead, never new result seeds or extra logical updates.

prior_startup_failures.reason: Launcher dereferenced venv Python symlink to base environment; Procgen import failed.
prior_startup_failures.selection_rule: Retry every startup failure with same seed and full protocol budget; no outcome-based seed selection.
